# Guard Captain (Kjalgrad)

## Basic Information
**Race:** Unknown  
**Gender:** Unknown  
**Title:** Captain of the Guard, [[Kjalgrad\|Kjalgrad]]  
**Location:** [[Kjalgrad\|Kjalgrad]]  
**Faction:** City Guard (funded by [[Info/Organizations/Guild_of_the_Silverroad\|Guild_of_the_Silverroad]])  
**Status:** Alive  
**Name:** Unknown — referred to in transcript as "Captain" (auto-generated transcript produced garbled readings; name unconfirmed)

## Description
The captain of the city guard in [[Kjalgrad\|Kjalgrad]]. Like all city guards here, this captain is on the [[Info/Organizations/Guild_of_the_Silverroad\|Guild_of_the_Silverroad]]'s payroll rather than the Jarl's. When citizens began disappearing after speaking out against the Guild's tariff increases, the captain confirmed that arrests had been made — but could not account for the missing people, as none of them appeared in the dungeon records.

The captain was encountered sitting at the [[Info/Locations/Frost_Gate_Hall\|Frost_Gate_Hall]] drinking mead in the morning when [[Info/Characters/001 The Fangs of Fjelhorst/Durov\|Durov]] approached.

## Key Interactions

### [[2 -  Sessions/Session 023\|Session 023]] — The Disappearances
After [[Info/Characters/001 The Fangs of Fjelhorst/Durov\|Durov]] de-escalated a crowd of citizens protesting the 45% tariff increases, he followed up with the guard captain:

- The captain confirmed that **arrests had been made** in connection with citizens speaking out
- However, **no one was in the dungeon** — the arrested individuals had simply vanished
- There were **no dungeon records** matching the descriptions of the missing citizens
- This suggests the Guild (or another party) is disappearing people outside of official channels

## Significance
This information is critical: it confirms the disappearances are not rumor — official arrests were made, yet the prisoners never appeared in the city's custody. This points to:

- The Guild intercepting arrested citizens before they reach the dungeon
- A secret holding location within the city
- The possibility of something far more sinister happening to those who speak out

## Relationship to the Guild
As a guard captain whose entire force is bankrolled by the [[Info/Organizations/Guild_of_the_Silverroad\|Guild_of_the_Silverroad]], the captain operates in a compromised environment. Whether personally complicit in the disappearances or simply powerless to investigate is unknown.

## Notes
- The captain did not appear personally alarmed by the disappearances, or at least gave no outward sign of it
- The party has not yet pressed the captain on what happened to the missing citizens
- The map in [[Info/Characters/999 NPC's/Valen_Marr\|Valen_Marr]]'s office showed two red circles in the warehouse district — possibly connected to holding or processing locations
- Was found drinking mead at the [[Info/Locations/Frost_Gate_Hall\|Frost_Gate_Hall]] when Durov approached in the morning

## Session References
